user.title: Connect to Emerald Electricity Advisor
user.description:
Set up your Emerald Electricity Advisor.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: Because this device requires a secure 6-digit passkey, you MUST pair it with your host operating system using `bluetoothctl` before completing this setup. If it is not paired at the OS level first, the connection will fail.

data_description.ble_address: The Bluetooth address of your Emerald device (found on device sticker)
data_description.name: Friendly name for this device

error.invalid_ble_address: Invalid BLE address format. Use XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX
